why: The iphone_safari profile returned playback_fail on a route that three Chromium profiles proved. Before recording that as a finding about iOS, the harness itself had to be questioned - and it is the cause. Playwright's WebKit build reports no native Apple HLS support and cannot accept MPEG-TS through MediaSource, so the one path real iOS Safari would use for this route does not exist in it. The route delivers MPEG-TS segments (/render.ts), so hls.js has to transmux in JavaScript, and that is what stalled.
conclusion: The iphone_safari verdict is scoped environment:iphone_safari and says nothing about iOS Safari. Real iOS coverage stays untested: it needs a physical device, which this environment does not have.
